Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} antitribu hold that their clan was once composed of knights and statesmen who, after the Anarch Revolt, evolved with the changing times - only to watch their elders tighten their grip on power and deny younger @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} their due. Rejecting the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}'s path as a disgrace, the Crusaders fight tirelessly to pave the way for Caine's childer, believing Cainites must one day dominate humanity as instruments of a greater destiny.

Disciplines: Dominate, Fortitude, Presence

Advantage: All Ventrue begin with an extra Resources Background Trait that can never be permanently lost, plus one Trait of Finance, High Society or Political Influence.

Disadvantage: Ventrue can feed only from mortal blood meeting a particular dietary restriction; any other mortal blood is reflexively regurgitated with no nourishment. This does not apply to vampiric vitae.

Organization: Ventrue antitribu see themselves as the vanguard of a coming Cainite order, often taking command roles within packs and pushing the sect toward disciplined, purposeful action.
